question: Should the experimental Claws package contract use `CLAW.md` as the canonical export artifact while retaining JSON only as an accepted input format?
rationale: The implementation creates a durable package-facing format choice across the unresolved Claws stack; tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose the long-term authoring and export contract.

options.title: Sponsor canonical `CLAW.md`
options.body: Approve the format direction and require a redacted end-to-end lifecycle proof before merging this slice after its stack prerequisites.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical
options.body: Retain grouped JSON as export output and treat `CLAW.md` as an input-only convenience until the package contract is separately approved.

options.title: Defer the format decision
options.body: Pause this final stack slice until the RFC and lifecycle stack establish a maintainer-approved package format direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor canonical `CLAW.md`
recommendation.body: Approve the format direction and require a redacted end-to-end lifecycle proof before merging this slice after its stack prerequisites.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contributor across the prior merged compatibility slice and the current stacked implementation; maintainer sponsorship remains required for the product decision.
